note: Extend freely. 'categories' give defaults; 'items' (keyed by vocabulary name) override. Never write 'safe to eat/drink/use', 'allergen-free' or doses here.

safety: Check the label for allergens and the expiry date. I cannot tell whether food is fresh or suitable for you.

Packaged Goods.description: A product sold in a pack, bottle, tube or jar.
safety: Check the printed label for ingredients, allergens, handling cautions and the expiry date.

Medicine and Health.description: An item used for health care.
safety: Confirm the name, purpose, dose and expiry date with the label or a pharmacist before using any medicine.

Machine and Appliance.description: A machine or appliance, usually powered by electricity or gas.
safety: Appliances use electricity or heat. Keep hands dry and clear of moving or hot parts, and switch off before cleaning.
Do not use damaged cables, chargers or batteries.

Tool.description: A tool for making or fixing things.
safety: Tools can injure. Handle edges, points and moving parts carefully.

Vehicle.description: A vehicle for moving people or goods.
safety: I cannot judge traffic or distance. Do not rely on SmartSight near roads.

Furniture.description: Furniture found in a home or office.

safety: Some plants can irritate the skin or be harmful if eaten. Do not eat or handle unknown plants.
Keep a safe distance from unfamiliar animals.

Person.description: A person is in view. SmartSight only says that someone is present and roughly where. It never identifies people.

safety: I can misread text. Check important details such as amounts and dates.
I cannot tell whether money is genuine. Ask someone you trust to check important notes.

Household Item.description: An everyday item found around the home.

Stationery.description: An item used for writing, drawing or office work.

Other.summary: an object I could not place in a category
Other.description: I could not place this object in a known category.

microwave oven.summary: An electric oven that heats food with microwaves.
microwave oven.operation: Put food in a microwave-safe container, close the door, set the time and power, then press start.
microwave oven.safety: Never put metal inside. Hot food and steam can burn.

refrigerator.summary: An electric cabinet that keeps food cold.
refrigerator.operation: Open the door to reach shelves; the temperature is set with a dial or panel inside.
refrigerator.safety: Check food dates yourself; I cannot tell if food has spoiled.

mixer grinder.summary: An electric appliance with jars and rotating blades.
mixer grinder.operation: Put food in the jar, lock the lid firmly, then turn the speed knob.
mixer grinder.safety: Sharp spinning blades. Never put fingers in the jar, and switch off before opening.

pressure cooker.summary: A sealed pot that cooks food quickly under steam pressure.
pressure cooker.operation: Add food and water, lock the lid, heat until it whistles, then let the pressure drop before opening.
pressure cooker.safety: Steam and pressure can scald. Never force the lid open.

gas stove.summary: A cooking stove that burns gas.
gas stove.operation: Turn the knob to light the burner, and turn it fully off after use.
gas stove.safety: Open flame. If you smell gas, switch everything off and get fresh air.

gas cylinder.summary: A metal cylinder holding cooking gas.
gas cylinder.operation: Connect the regulator to the valve and switch the regulator on to start the gas.
gas cylinder.safety: Flammable. Keep away from flames and switch off the regulator when not in use.

washing machine.operation: Load clothes, add detergent, choose a programme and start.
washing machine.safety: Switch off power and water before cleaning or if it leaks.

clothes iron.summary: An electric appliance with a hot flat plate.
clothes iron.operation: Plug in, set the temperature dial for the fabric, wait for it to heat, then press.
clothes iron.safety: The plate gets very hot. Unplug when finished.

electric kettle.summary: A jug that boils water with electricity.
electric kettle.operation: Fill with water, put it on its base and switch on; it usually switches itself off.
electric kettle.safety: Boiling water and steam can scald.

ceiling fan.summary: A fan fixed to the ceiling.
ceiling fan.used_for: moving air to cool a room
ceiling fan.operation: Switch on at the wall and set the speed with the regulator.
ceiling fan.safety: Do not touch the blades while they spin.

air conditioner.summary: An appliance that cools room air.
air conditioner.operation: Use the remote control to switch on, set temperature and fan speed.

electric drill.summary: A powered drill that spins bits.
electric drill.operation: Fit the right bit, hold firmly with both hands, then press the trigger.
electric drill.safety: Wear eye protection and keep fingers away from the bit.

angle grinder.summary: A powered tool with a fast spinning disc.
angle grinder.used_for: cutting and grinding metal or stone
angle grinder.operation: Fit a suitable disc, keep the guard on, hold with both hands and press the switch.
angle grinder.safety: Very dangerous: sparks and a fast spinning disc. Use eye protection and unplug before changing discs.

lawn mower.operation: Start the motor, then walk behind the handle to push it.
lawn mower.safety: Spinning blades. Keep hands and feet away and switch off before clearing blockages.

laptop.operation: Open the lid and press the power button; use the keyboard and touchpad.

mobile phone.summary: A handheld phone with a touch screen.
mobile phone.operation: Press the side button to wake it, then use the touch screen.

television.operation: Use the remote control to switch on and change channel or volume.

remote control.used_for: controlling a television or other appliance from a distance
remote control.operation: Point it at the device and press the buttons.

power bank.operation: Connect a cable from its port to your device; a button usually shows charge.
power bank.safety: Do not use if it is swollen, hot or damaged.

scissors.summary: A cutting tool with two blades.
scissors.operation: Put fingers through the handles and open and close the blades.

knife.summary: A cutting tool with a blade.
knife.operation: Hold the handle firmly and cut away from your body.
knife.safety: Sharp blade. Find the handle before touching the blade.

hammer.summary: A hand tool with a heavy head.
hammer.operation: Hold the handle near the end and swing from the wrist and elbow.
hammer.safety: Keep fingers clear of the striking area.

screwdriver.summary: A hand tool with a tip that fits screws.
screwdriver.operation: Fit the tip into the screw head and turn the handle.

stapler.summary: A desk tool that joins sheets of paper with staples.
stapler.operation: Place the pages under the head and press down firmly.

pen.operation: Remove the cap or click it, then write.

calculator.summary: A small electronic device for arithmetic.
calculator.operation: Press the on button, type numbers and operations, then press equals.

shampoo bottle.summary: A bottle of liquid soap for hair.
shampoo bottle.operation: Wet hair, put a small amount on the hair, rub in, then rinse.
shampoo bottle.safety: Avoid contact with eyes; rinse well if it gets in.

toothpaste tube.summary: A tube of paste for cleaning teeth.
toothpaste tube.operation: Squeeze a small amount on a brush and brush, then rinse your mouth.

hand sanitiser bottle.summary: A bottle of alcohol-based gel or liquid.
hand sanitiser bottle.operation: Rub a small amount over the hands until dry.
hand sanitiser bottle.safety: Flammable and not for drinking. Keep away from children and flames.

detergent packet.operation: Follow the amount printed on the pack.
detergent packet.safety: Not for eating or drinking. Keep away from children, and check the label for handling cautions.

medicine strip.summary: A foil strip of tablets or capsules.
medicine strip.used_for: a medicine; the purpose is printed on the pack
medicine strip.operation: Use only as written on the label or as directed by a doctor.
medicine strip.safety: I cannot tell what the medicine is for or the right dose. Read the label or ask a pharmacist.

cough syrup bottle.used_for: a medicine; the purpose is printed on the label
cough syrup bottle.operation: Use only as written on the label or as directed by a doctor.
cough syrup bottle.safety: I cannot give doses. Read the label or ask a pharmacist.

thermometer.summary: A device that measures body temperature.
thermometer.operation: Place it as instructed for its type and wait for the reading or beep.

glucometer.summary: A device that measures blood sugar.
glucometer.operation: Insert a test strip, apply a drop of blood and read the result.
glucometer.safety: Results should be discussed with a doctor.

syringe.summary: A plastic tube with a plunger and needle.
syringe.used_for: giving injections or measuring liquid medicine
syringe.operation: Used by or under the guidance of a health professional.
syringe.safety: The needle is sharp. Do not touch it, and ask a health professional about use.

500 rupee note.used_for: payment; the value printed on it is five hundred rupees
500 rupee note.safety: I cannot confirm whether a note is genuine.

100 rupee note.used_for: payment; the value printed on it is one hundred rupees
100 rupee note.safety: I cannot confirm whether a note is genuine.

bicycle.summary: A two-wheeled vehicle moved by pedalling.
bicycle.operation: Sit on the saddle, hold the handlebars and pedal; brakes are levers on the handlebars.

helmet.summary: A hard hat for the head.
helmet.used_for: protecting the head when riding or working
helmet.operation: Put it on and fasten the strap under the chin.

umbrella.summary: A folding canopy on a stick.
umbrella.operation: Press the button or slide the runner to open.

wristwatch.summary: A watch worn on the wrist.

spectacles.summary: Glasses with lenses held on a frame.
spectacles.used_for: helping vision or protecting the eyes

backpack.summary: A bag carried on the back.

cup.summary: A small open container with a handle.

reusable water bottle.operation: Unscrew the cap to drink or fill.

lighter.summary: A small device that makes a flame.
lighter.operation: Press or roll the wheel or button to make a flame.
lighter.safety: Open flame and flammable fuel. Keep away from children.

matchbox.operation: Strike a match against the side of the box.
matchbox.safety: Open flame. Keep away from children.

padlock.operation: Open with its key or code.

candle.summary: A wax stick with a wick.
candle.safety: Open flame. Never leave it burning unattended.

extension board.summary: A multi-socket power strip with a cable.
extension board.used_for: powering several devices from one wall socket
extension board.safety: Do not overload it or use it if the cable is damaged.

snake.safety: Some snakes are dangerous. Keep away and do not touch.
